## Design

### 2026-09-30 — Today, I started planning my first hardware project called a 'Mini Servo Controller' using an Arduino Nano. I researched and selected all the necessary components, including an SG90 micro servo motor,

**1.5h**

Today, I started planning my first hardware project called a 'Mini Servo Controller' using an Arduino Nano. I researched and selected all the necessary components, including an SG90 micro servo motor, a 10k ohm rotary potentiometer for angle control, and a breadboard with jumper wires kit to set up the circuit. I also created a GitHub repository to track my progress and organized the Bill of Materials (BOM) within the $30 Tier 1 budget.
